mapper.select: -- 같은 source의 불변 판정 전체를 센다. 현재 effective 여부는 별도 projection을 사용한다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e WHERE e.source_id=#{sourceId}

-- 당시 자동 태그만 반환하며 별도의 관리자 확정 태그와 혼합하지 않는다. SELECT c.category_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e ON e.id=t.evaluation_id JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE e.source_id=#{sourceId} AND e.id=#{evaluationId} AND t.origin_code='AUTO' ORDER BY c.category_code

-- 과거 정책의 비활성 카탈로그도 당시 자동 판정 근거로 보존한다. SELECT c.support_type_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e ON e.id=t.evaluation_id JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE e.source_id=#{sourceId} AND e.id=#{evaluationId} AND t.origin_code='AUTO' ORDER BY c.support_type_code

-- 같은 source이더라도 다른 판정의 파일을 현재 필터로 사용하지 못한다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_attachment_evaluation_inputs WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} AND file_id=#{fileId})
mapper.sql: FROM announcement_source_attachment_evaluation_inputs i JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e ON e.id=i.evaluation_id AND e.source_id=i.source_id AND e.set_id=i.set_id JOIN announcement_source_attachment_files f ON f.id=i.file_id AND f.source_id=i.source_id AND f.set_id=i.set_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_extractions x ON x.id=i.extraction_id AND x.file_id=i.file_id AND x.source_id=i.source_id AND x.set_id=i.set_id WHERE i.source_id=#{sourceId} AND i.evaluation_id=#{evaluationId}
mapper.select: -- 추출 없는 실패 파일도 입력 count에서 제외하지 않는다. SELECT count(1)

-- 당시 입력의 exact extraction ID를 사용한다. 최신 attempt/다른 set의 결과로 대체하지 않는다. SELECT i.file_id,i.extraction_id,i.document_role_code,i.input_status_code,f.download_status_code, f.error_code AS download_error_code,x.quality_code,x.error_code AS extraction_error_code, x.created_at AS extracted_at,x.reused_from_extraction_id ORDER BY f.sort_order,i.file_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM announcement_source_attachment_matches m JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e ON e.id=m.evaluation_id AND e.source_id=m.source_id AND e.set_id=m.set_id AND e.rule_release_id=m.rule_release_id JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluation_inputs i ON i.evaluation_id=m.evaluation_id AND i.source_id=m.source_id AND i.set_id=m.set_id AND i.file_id=m.file_id AND i.extraction_id=m.extraction_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups g ON g.id=m.keyword_group_id AND g.release_id=m.rule_release_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules r ON r.id=m.keyword_rule_id AND r.group_id=g.id JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms t ON t.id=m.keyword_term_id AND t.keyword_rule_id=r.id WHERE m.source_id=#{sourceId} AND m.evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} AND m.file_id=#{fileId}
mapper.select: -- 목록과 같은 source/evaluation/file scope를 사용한다. SELECT count(1)

-- 전체 추출 텍스트/URL을 조회하지 않는다. 좌표를 기존 제한된 block 조회에 연결한다. SELECT m.id,m.file_id,m.extraction_id,i.document_role_code,m.keyword_group_id,g.group_code, m.keyword_rule_id,r.rule_code,m.keyword_term_id,t.term_text,m.applied_action_code,m.block_index,m.start_offset,m.end_offset ORDER BY m.file_id,m.block_index,m.start_offset,m.end_offset,m.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
